title: Open Inventory
setup: Check the Open Inventory URL, API key with read access and connectivity in settings. Then reload the item selection.

settings.intro: Connect your Open Inventory instance and choose the stock to display. An API key with read access is sufficient.
settings.search: Filter by name or SKU (all items)
settings.title: Custom display title (optional)
settings.failed: Connection failed. Check URL, API key with stock read permission and connectivity. Local instances require an integration-server allowlist entry.
settings.changed: Setting updated. Finish by saving in Paperlesspaper.
settings.invalidTimeZone: Enter a valid time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin.
